g.text: (WhatsApp Web's own UI, edge to edge under the header)
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.
Opened from the green WhatsApp mark in the sidebar strip, which is shown active. Before the page is ready the pane reads 'Opening WhatsApp…'.
⟳ is 'Reload WhatsApp' (enabled once ready, also on F5), 🌐 is 'Open in your browser', and ⧉ moves the page with its browser into a window of its own.
One WebView2 serves every visit and is hidden, not closed, when you leave. Its profile stays on disk, so the QR code is scanned once. The server's /whatsapp API is not used.
WhatsApp is the only web app (WEB_APP_WHATSAPP) the screen defines.
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
